claimant_lives_in_uk.description: Whether the claimant lives in the UK.

children.description: A list of children the claimant is claiming for.

lives_with_claimant.description: Whether the child lives with the claimant.

in_approved_education.description: Whether the child is in approved education or training (e.g. A-levels, GCSEs, NVQ up to level 3). Only relevant for children aged 16-19.

in_extension_period.description: Whether the child (aged 16 or 17) has left education and registered with a government-sponsored careers service or the armed forces (qualifying for a 20-week extension).

upkeep_per_week.description: The amount in £ per week the claimant contributes towards the child's upkeep (food, clothes, pocket money, etc.). Only relevant if the child does not live with the claimant.

another_claimant_has_priority.description: Whether another person who also lives with the child has priority for claiming Child Benefit.

another_claimant_lives_with_child.description: Whether someone who lives with the child is already claiming Child Benefit for them.

care_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in local authority care.

care_home_24h_per_week.description: Whether the child spends at least 24 hours per week at home while in local authority care.

hospital_weeks.description: The number of weeks the child has been in hospital or residential accommodation.

claimant_spends_on_child.description: Whether the claimant regularly spends money on the child (e.g. food, clothes, books) while the child is in hospital or residential accommodation.

is_fostered.description: Whether the child is fostered by the claimant.

council_pays_for_child.description: Whether the local council pays towards the child's accommodation or maintenance.

works_24_plus_hours.description: Whether the child works 24 or more hours per week in paid employment.

started_apprenticeship_in_england.description: Whether the child has started an apprenticeship in England.

receives_qualifying_benefits.description: Whether the child receives qualifying benefits in their own right, such as Universal Credit or Employment and Support Allowance.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Hello! I'm happy to help you determine your eligibility for Child Benefit. To do this properly, I'll need to gather some information about you and your children.

Let me start with a basic question:

**How many children are you inquiring about, and what are their names?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Hi there! I'm inquiring about my son Alex. He's my only child.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for that information! So you're inquiring about your son **Alex**.

To assess your eligibility for Child Benefit for Alex, I need to gather some details about your circumstances. Let me start with the first question:

**How old is Alex?**

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you. Now I need to understand your living situation with Alex.

**Does Alex live with you?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, he lives at home with me.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Good, thank you. Now I have a few more questions about Alex's circumstances.

**Is Alex in full-time education or training?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, he's in sixth form college studying for his A-levels.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Thank you for that information. That's helpful.

**Are you a British citizen, or do you have settled status or the right to reside in the UK?**

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, I live in Manchester, so I'm here in the UK.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text: Thank you. Before I can give you a final assessment, I need to check the exact eligibility rules to ensure I'm applying them correctly.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Perfect! I've reviewed the eligibility rules. Based on the information you've provided, let me confirm a couple of final details to ensure I have everything correct:

**Just to confirm - you are a British citizen or have the legal right to reside in the UK, correct?** (You mentioned you live in Manchester, but I want to confirm your immigration status to ensure you meet the residency requirements.)

conversation.author: actor
conversation.text: Yes, that's right, I have the right to reside here in the UK.

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
Excellent! Thank you for confirming that. I now have all the information I need to assess your eligibility for Child Benefit for Alex.

Let me provide my assessment:

conversation.author: eligibility_agent
conversation.text:
**Great news!** You are **eligible for Child Benefit for Alex**.

Here's why:
- Alex is 17 and under 20 years old
- He is in approved full-time education (sixth form college studying A-levels)
- He lives with you and you are responsible for him
- You have the right to reside in the UK

You can continue to claim Child Benefit for Alex as long as he remains in approved education. However, please note that if Alex:
- Stops full-time education or training, or
- Starts paid work for 24 hours or more per week, or
- Starts an apprenticeship in England

Then your eligibility would end (though you may be eligible for a 20-week extension period if he leaves education to register with a careers service or the armed services).

Is there anything else you'd like to know about your eligibility?
